title: I used Claude and Polyform to make my dream factory game
author: andreadev3d
selftext:
Playable Link: [https://andreadev3d.itch.io/cozy-factory-demo?secret=GleSUPtqnv6N7XXDlp5h4iNQo](https://andreadev3d.itch.io/cozy-factory-demo?secret=GleSUPtqnv6N7XXDlp5h4iNQo)

Cozy Factory is a calm factory and automation game on a sleepy archipelago, made by me as a solo developer. You start with a small plot of land, a single ore patch and a Market. Place Miners on the ore, drag belts to carry it, smelt it into bars in a Furnace, and sell everything at the Market to earn money for your next machine. Every machine needs power, so you'll lay cables and grow a power grid, light the steam works, and expand your island plot by plot. Contracts from the islanders, a research tree and new machines open up as you go. There are no timers to fail and no rush: play at your own pace, pause any time, and your island saves as you go. This free demo covers the opening and the first stretch of land, about 45 minutes of play.
